headline: Brent Crude Hits Five-Month High Above $114 Amid Middle East Escalation Fears
summary: Brent crude rose to $114.72 a barrel, reaching its highest level in over five months amid fears of renewed US strikes on Iran.
why: Oil prices are a crucial input cost for global transportation, manufacturing, and energy sectors, directly influencing headline inflation worldwide.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Rising crude oil prices directly increase revenues and profit margins for oil exploration and production companies.

why_moved: Geopolitical conflict risks in oil-producing regions threaten immediate supply disruptions, driving up futures prices.
